jurisdiction_name: SIL LAKE DIST A (SILVER LAKE VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Sil Lake Dist A (Village of Silver Lake Village) has 501 registered voters, with 52.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 24.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 23.6%, a narrow Republican lean of 0.8 percentage points.
